phrase.zh: 从同一个起点，走向不同的人生。
phrase.en: From one beginning, lives take different paths.

visual.zh: 正前方台阶通向共同平台，再向左上和右上分成两路；两侧栏杆沿台阶延伸，平台下方的阴影衬出石面的层次。
visual.en: Foreground steps reach a shared landing and divide into flights toward the upper left and upper right. Rails follow the stairs, while shadows beneath the landing give depth to the stone surfaces.

background.zh:
杜·加尔因在长篇系列《蒂博一家》中有力而真实地描写人类冲突和当代生活的重要方面，获得1937年诺贝尔文学奖，独享该奖。这组小说呈现第一次世界大战前的法国社会与家庭成员的不同命运。画面让一段楼梯在共同平台上分成左右两路，寓意共同出身与不同选择；建筑是原创象征，不是书中场景或真实地点的复原。短句为原创。
1937年文学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：在长篇系列《蒂博一家》中有力而真实地描写人类冲突和当代生活的重要方面
background.en:
Martin du Gard received the sole 1937 Nobel Prize in Literature for the power and truth of his depiction of human conflict and contemporary life in Les Thibault. The novel-cycle portrays pre-First World War French society and divergent family destinies. A staircase splitting from a common landing symbolizes shared origins and different choices. The building is an original metaphor, not a reconstruction of a novel scene or real location. The phrase is original.
1937 — The Nobel Prize in Literature. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for the artistic power and truth with which he has depicted human conflict as well as some fundamental aspects of contemporary life in his novel-cycle Les Thibault
